lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ is in the derivative form: تَرَاقِي
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ت/ر/ق   t–r–q (no evidence of verbal root) collarbone, the uppermost of the chest. Of this root, only تَرَاقِي tarāqı occurs 1 time
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَرَاقِي tarāqı (read as تَرَاق tarāq, with the final ı elided, for rhyming harmony with following verses) [pl. of n. تَرْقُوَةٌ tarquwatun] collarbone, the uppermost part of the chest *

(75:26) إِذَا بَلَغَتِ التَّرَاقِيَ when life is about to abandon the body; when a person is on the point of expiring [lit. when it [the soul, life, last breath] reaches the collarbone].
